capability: Corrected EM finite spectra and candidates
Compose EM cases, corrected finite matrices and original-order spectra with bounded numerical evidence.
operation: compute finite rational EM wavevector spectra
inverse: angular frequency to finite-model spectrum
discovery.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
discovery.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
discovery.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits

excluded: No claim that every auxiliary eigenvalue is a kinetic physical mode; no infinite-mode completeness or cross-thread invariance.
preconditions: Declared local Python runtime (Python 3.14, NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.18.1); single-threaded BLAS environment.
Declared Python 3.14 runtime with NumPy 2.5.4 and SciPy 1.18.1; no external runtime is required.
supported: Two cases, J8/J12, all eight N controls and source79-frequency default.
All finite spectra, original-order values, selection candidates and terminal matrices.

example.description: Pure Python/NumPy implementation; executes on this macOS host without the reference runtime.
example.expected: PASS: the example runs locally and returns the declared output structure.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear search candidate semantics in this API. Precision/tail failures are explicit ValueError; EM eigen residual and insufficient-selection failures are explicit ValueError where applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Errors return no result; no failed or partial execution is presented as a successful output.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Python numerical errors propagate with operation context; no native runtime, source checkout or network fallback is selected.

assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.definition: All finite matrix eigenvalues are returned. Selected5 are heuristic positive-real, least-|imaginary| candidates. The current diagnostic error fields are zero placeholders; the claimed 2e-12 physical gate is not computed.
identity.direction: inverse: angular frequency to finite-model spectrum
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation

outputs.constraints: State and terminal diagnostics retain scientific meaning; no caller state mutation.

outputs.units: mixed SI and dimensionless as described
